paper_title: Impact of bread diet on intestinal dysbiosis and irritable bowel syndrome symptoms in quiescent ulcerative colitis: A pilot study

pico.patient: person with ulcerative colitis and irritable bowel syndrome
pico.outcome: The intake of a bread baked using traditional elaboration decreased the Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes ratio, which seemed to be associated with improving IBS-like symptoms in quiescent ulcerative colitis patients.

supplement: pilot study. inetervention_period_day changes the unit from weeks to days.
